name: rask-example-wasm-islands
description: Island dependencies for the islands page of the rask.sh site: React (and react-colorful, used as a package island), Vue, Svelte and Solid. The Lit-runtime island on that page is a plain custom element and needs no package. No Angular, whose toolchain this bundle does not carry, and no Preact, whose Vite plugin npm cannot install beside React's.
